features: High Capacity: With 10,000mAh capacity, PowerVolt 101 provides dependable backup power for smartphones, tablets, earbuds, smartwatches and other compatible devices, helping you stay powered throughout the day
22.5W Fast Charging Support: Delivers up to 22.5W output for compatible devices, helping provide a quick power boost when you need to recharge while travelling, commuting or away from a wall charger.

LED Battery Percentage Display: The built-in digital display clearly shows the remaining battery percentage, making it easy to monitor available power and know when the power bank needs to be recharged.
Smart Chip Safety Protection: Intelligent protection helps safeguard against overcharging, overheating, overcurrent and short circuits, providing added protection during everyday charging.
